text:
Hi everyone,
I’m looking for a recommendation for a great, independent immigration lawyer to guide us through the Shared Life Procedure at the Ministry of Interior.

My partner is a Swedish citizen. Our case is completely straightforward with no complications, and all of her official documents from Sweden are already prepared, translated, and stamped with an Apostille.

We need representation strictly for Stage 1 (file preparation, online submission, interview prep, and physical accompaniment to the Ministry of Interior office until the B/1 work visa is issued).

Our budget for the attorney fee for this stage is 3,500 ILS + VAT (including the physical meeting accompaniment).

Please comment below or send me a DM if this is relevant for you.

Thank you so much!!
